name: Sonnet growth at a reasonable price
strategy: Round 2: rotate into quality mega-cap and select mid-cap growth names trading at reasonable multiples relative to durable earnings growth, add small-cap breadth exposure, stay out of crypto's ongoing bear market, and hedge frothy speculative excess with a modest short.

positions.thesis: Azure/AI cloud growth compounding at a still-reasonable multiple vs. peers; diversified enterprise moat limits drawdown risk after April volatility.
Cheapest mega-cap grower on a P/E-to-growth basis; Search+Cloud+YouTube diversify AI monetization while trading below peer multiples.
Custom silicon/networking beneficiary of AI infra buildout with more reasonable valuation than the SOXL basket after the recent semis correction.
Ad-revenue growth reaccelerating with AI-driven engagement/targeting gains, reasonable multiple relative to growth versus other AI plays.
Small caps still catching up (+19.4% H1 but lagging QQQ historically); broadening rally and eventual rate relief support continued rotation.
Deeply out-of-favor quality compounder; depressed multiple provides GARP entry with earnings growth resuming, adds healthcare sector diversification.
Defensive, steady membership-driven growth compounder to balance high-beta AI exposure; resilient through the April drawdown pattern.
Energy sector diversifier trading cheap on cash-flow yield, low correlation to AI-infra correction risk, dividend support.
Small leveraged tap on continued Nasdaq momentum post-correction, sized modestly given amplified drawdown risk.
Crypto remains in a deep bear (BTC/ETH/SOL all down double digits H1); Coinbase trading volumes and multiple exposed to further downside, funds the hedge cheaply without touching crypto directly.

outlook: Expect continued rotation from overextended AI-infra momentum names into broader, reasonably-valued quality growth and small caps, with crypto remaining pressured through year-end; keeping meaningful cash cushions against another April-style drawdown.
